result.summary: The page overall looks clean and well-structured; only a couple of minor visual inconsistencies were found.

issues.description: The heart/favorite icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card is outlined white on a light-toned image area, while a similar icon on the pizza card below is filled dark, creating inconsistent icon styling across similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon's style (color/fill) across all restaurant cards regardless of background image.

issues.description: The green promotional banner text uses a bullet separator ('·') between the promo code and minimum order text, which is a small stylistic inconsistency compared to other list separators used elsewhere in the app.
issues.suggestion: Keep separator style consistent throughout the app for a more polished look.
